SELECT sum(rAmt) as realizedAmt, sum(eAmt) as extractAmt,
A.年 AS cdate,
A.月 AS cdate,
A.季 AS cdate,
A.sdate AS cdate,
null as product, null as amtFlag
A.BOOKSET_ID AS product, null as cdate, null as amtFlag
A.amtFlag AS amtFlag, null as cdate, null as product
A.年 AS cdate,
A.月 AS cdate,
A.季 AS cdate,
A.sdate AS cdate,
A.BOOKSET_ID AS product, null as amtFlag
A.amtFlag AS amtFlag, null as product
'' as one, null as cdate, null as product, null as amtFlag
FROM (SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID, IFNULL(CASE A.type WHEN 'B' THEN A.amt ELSE NULL END,0) AS rAmt, IFNULL(CASE A.type WHEN 'A' THEN -1*A.amt ELSE NULL END,0) AS eAmt, CASE C.PROFIT_FLAG WHEN '03' THEN '02' ELSE '01' END AS amtFlag, DATE_FORMAT(A.HAPPEN_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS sdate, DATE_FORMAT(A.HAPPEN_DATE,'yyyy') AS 年, CONCAT_WS('', YEAR(DATE_FORMAT(A.HAPPEN_DATE,'%y%m%d')), '/', quarter(DATE_FORMAT(A.HAPPEN_DATE,'yyyy/q')), '季度') AS 季, CONCAT_WS('', YEAR(DATE_FORMAT(A.HAPPEN_DATE,'%y%m%d')), '/', MONTH(DATE_FORMAT(A.HAPPEN_DATE,'%y%m%d')), '月') AS 月
FROM ( /**计提损益*/ SELECT 'B' AS type, D.HAPPEN_DATE, M.BOOKSET_ID, (CASE D.CD_FLAG WHEN 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*D.HAPPEN_AMT AS amt FROM BOK_VOUCH_MAIN M LEFT JOIN BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL D on D.VOUCH_NUM = M.VOUCH_NUM WHERE D.TABLE_ID in ('8103','8105') AND D.SUBJECT_NO in ('22060201','22060101')
UNION ALL /**支付损益*/ SELECT 'A' AS type, D.HAPPEN_DATE, M.BOOKSET_ID, (CASE D.CD_FLAG WHEN 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*D.HAPPEN_AMT AS amt FROM BOK_VOUCH_MAIN M LEFT JOIN BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL D on D.VOUCH_NUM = M.VOUCH_NUM WHERE D.TABLE_ID in ('8104','8106')
AND D.SUBJECT_NO in
#{item}
) A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B on A.BOOKSET_ID=B.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C on B.FINPROD_ID=C.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
AND A.HAPPEN_DATE >=STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.HAPPEN_DATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{item}
) A
GROUP BY
A.年,
A.月,
A.季,
A.sdate,
A.amtFlag
A.BOOKSET_ID
GROUP BY
A.年
A.月
A.季
A.sdate
GROUP BY
A.amtFlag
A.BOOKSET_ID
GROUP BY ''
